				<div class="et_pb_text_inner">A native of Columbus, Ohio, Louis Ng is an audio engineer, videographer, and musician based out of Southern California. He is the owner of Lenson Productions and frequently records and films concerts and recording sessions in performance halls all over Southern California. Louis regularly provides his on-location recording services for Chamber Music | OC, Sunset ChamberFest, University of Southern California, and The Colburn School. </p>
<p>Louis holds multiple positions outside of Lenson Productions. As an in-house audio engineer for the record label, mediaHYPERIUM, Louis has worked on specialized surround sound and 3D audio projects. Louis is also a consultant and video content creator for Mixed in Key, a music software company that creates composition and music analysis tools for DJs and producers. </p>
<p>Louis received his Bachelor of Music degree from the Cleveland Institute of Music with a major in Audio Engineering and a minor in Piano Performance.</div>
